answer: Voyage work-slot bond: each identity holds one slot on a roster, locks 70, burns 30, one key, one slot. Each epoch it sails one shift, filing a key-signed log; falcon auditors check logs at zenith. Missed shift, reused log or shared slot burns the bond. First fake costs 30, k-th 30+4(k-1); 1,000 fakes burn 2,028,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A hired crew sailing two voyages on one key loses both bonds; an honest agent pays 30 once.
